overview: The committee discussed a proposed resolution concerning law enforcement identification and Fourth Amendment rights, ultimately voting to keep the paper in committee for further research and stakeholder feedback.

items.title: Paper 26-031: Resolution to Require Law Enforcement Identification and Protect Fourth Amendment Rights
items.summary: The committee voted to keep in committee a proposed resolution restricting officer mask-wearing and reinforcing Fourth Amendment protections, allowing sponsors to seek feedback from local police, legal experts, and community advocacy groups.
